Evidence and priority policy
ML=1 + verified Wazuh=1 → High Priority ML=0 + verified Wazuh=1 → Needs Review No attributable positive → Evidence Unavailable Query failure / invalid evidence → investigation
The generic fusion function also supports verified 0/0 and 1/0. The operational matcher does not currently prove a negative from absent alerts.
